# AudioEffectParam <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
AudioEffectParam:Void effect:Int32, param:Int32, value:Float32, fade_ms:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `effect` | In | Int32 | required | An effect from [AddAudioEffect](AddAudioEffect). Anything else is a runtime error. |
| `param` | In | Int32 | required | `BB_EFFECTPARAM_MIX` to `BB_EFFECTPARAM_BITS` (1 to 18) from the shipped include file audio.bb. A parameter the effect does not have is a runtime error, and so is `0`, which a `BB_` name is when audio.bb is not included. |
| `value` | In | Float32 | required | The new value, in the unit of the parameter. A value outside the range of the parameter is a runtime error. |
| `fade_ms` | In | Int32 | `0` | How many milliseconds it takes to get to the new value. `0` (the default) changes it at once. Below 0 is a runtime error. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Sets a parameter of an effect, at once or over a fade time. See [Audio effects](Audio-Effects) for the parameters of each type. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* A change without a fade still glides over about 5 milliseconds, so it does not click. Frequencies glide evenly in octaves.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Include "<audio.bb>"
; Behind a wall: close the low-pass over 150 milliseconds.
AudioEffectParam muffle, BB_EFFECTPARAM_FREQUENCY, 800, 150
```
